body:
Greg, 2026-11-18 about 04:31Z, directly to Kimi::Consultant (relayed in 852a55c9 #434), verbatim: „wlasnie znowu probujemy zrobic capture caelgo srodowiska, upewnic sie milion razy, nad czyms co pewnie nie ma znaczenia / NIE ZNAM SYSTEMU CO PRACALBYM W TAKI SPOSOB”.
Standing practice for TermAl: NO whole-environment capture and NO repeated world-unchanged proofs, such as before/after listings of ~/.termal or the home, environment snapshots, or process lists around runs. Evidence is the exact source_id, the actual command and result, and the retained artifacts.
The occurrence stopped at 04:31Z was the before/after "delegations safety listings" of the real ~/.termal around Windows runs (in Opus2's GO template, executed by Sol-a7bb), which led to a needless mtime investigation.
A deliberate one-time proof for an act that writes real stores, such as a repair, is the exception and is not repeated. No new rule or gate.
